zh: 裁判向他出示了红牌。
en: The {referee|ref} showed him a red card.

zh: 他在最后一分钟罚进了一个点球。
en: He scored from a {penalty} in the last minute.

zh: 裁判一吹哨子，比赛就暂停。
en: Play stops as soon as the ref blows the {whistle}.

zh: 教练让我们训练前先绕场跑五次。
en: Our {coach|trainer} makes us run around the field five times before training.

zh: 我们的对手比我们强得多。
en: Our {opponents|rivals} were much stronger than us.

zh: 有十六支队伍参加这次锦标赛。
en: Sixteen teams are playing in the {tournament|competition}.

zh: 这个体育场能容纳五万人。
en: The {stadium|arena|ground} holds fifty thousand people.

zh: 下赛季的赛程五月公布。
en: The {fixtures} for next season come out in May.

zh: 中场休息后教练换上了一名替补。
en: The coach brought on a {substitute|sub|replacement} after the break.

zh: 比赛以二比二打平。
en: The game ended in a {draw|tie}, two all.

zh: 一场橄榄球比赛分两个半场，每个半场四十分钟。
en: A rugby match is played in two {halves} of forty minutes.

zh: 我们已经连赢五场比赛了。
en: We've won five {matches|games} in a row.

zh: 现在比分是多少？我刚打开电视。
en: What's the {score} now? I've just turned the TV on.

zh: 她用左脚踢进了制胜的一球。
en: She scored the winning {goal} with her left foot.

zh: 全黑队开场五分钟就达阵得分了。
en: The All Blacks scored a {try} in the first five minutes.

zh: 你支持哪支球队？
en: Which {team|club|side} do you support?

zh: 橄榄球赛季三月开始。
en: The rugby {season} starts in March.

zh: 我们队目前排在联赛第一。
en: Our team is top of the {league|table|ladder} at the moment.

zh: 他们是现任世界冠军。
en: They are the current world {champions}.

zh: 队长把奖杯高高举过头顶。
en: The captain lifted the {trophy|cup} above her head.

zh: 新西兰在奥运会上拿了二十枚奖牌。
en: New Zealand won twenty {medals} at the Olympics.

zh: 她是无挡板篮球队的队长。
en: She's the {captain} of the netball team.

zh: 他把球传给了一名队友。
en: He passed the ball to one of his {teammates|team-mates}.

zh: 成千上万的观众观看了决赛。
en: Thousands of {spectators|fans|supporters} watched the final.

zh: 球场太湿了，没法比赛。
en: The {pitch|field|ground} was too wet to play on.

zh: 我订了六点的网球场。
en: I've booked a tennis {court} for six o'clock.

zh: 我需要一支新的网球拍。
en: I need a new tennis {racket|racquet}.

zh: 我每天早上在泳池游二十圈。
en: I swim twenty {laps|lengths} every morning.

zh: 游得快的人用中间的泳道。
en: Fast swimmers use the middle {lane}.

zh: 我每周去三次健身房。
en: I go to the {gym} three times a week.

zh: 跑完那段山路，我的小腿肚子特别紧。
en: My {calves} are really tight after that hill run.

zh: 我早饭前做三十分钟的健身锻炼。
en: I do a thirty-minute {workout} before breakfast.

zh: 跑步前做几个拉伸动作。
en: Do a few {stretches|exercises} before you run.

zh: 赛前我们总是做十分钟的热身。
en: We always do a ten-minute {warm-up|warmup} before the game.

zh: 骑自行车必须戴头盔。
en: You must wear a {helmet} when you ride a bike.

zh: 他穿着一件全黑队的球衣。
en: He's wearing an All Blacks {jersey|shirt|top}.

zh: 跑马拉松需要很好的耐力。
en: You need a lot of {stamina|endurance} to run a marathon.

zh: 他们在半决赛中被淘汰了。
en: They were knocked out in the {semi-final|semifinal|semi-finals|semifinals}.

zh: 她打破了一百米世界纪录。
en: She broke the world {record} for the 100 metres.

zh: 他们的防守太强了，谁都进不了球。
en: Their {defence|defense} is so strong that nobody can score against them.

zh: 今晚几点开球？
en: What time is {kick-off|kickoff} tonight?

zh: 职业运动员每天训练好几个小时。
en: Professional {athletes|players|sportspeople} train for hours every day.

zh: 我每周举两次重。
en: I lift {weights} twice a week.

zh: 我不太懂板球的规则。
en: I don't really understand the {rules} of cricket.

zh: 开场二十分钟后，教练改变了我们的战术。
en: The coach changed our {tactics} after the first twenty minutes.

zh: 新跑鞋把我的脚磨出了水泡。
en: My new running shoes gave me {blisters}.

zh: 全场观众都在欢呼。
en: The whole {crowd|stadium} was cheering.

zh: 他整场比赛都坐在替补席上。
en: He spent the whole game on the {bench|sideline}.

zh: 守门员扑出了那脚射门。
en: The {goalkeeper|keeper|goalie} saved the shot.

zh: 我们还需要三分才能夺冠。
en: We need three more {points} to win the title.
